# testdata

This folder contains fixtures for the evenotification package.

- notifications.json: Initial set of fixtures hand-crafted from real notifications
- notifications_2.json: Added set of fixtures. based on real notifications and anonymized with Claude AI
- notifications_3.json: Fixtures fully generated from existing notification structs in the goesi-openapi library by Claude AI
- notifications_4.json: Set of fixtures hand-crafted from real notifications and taking from aa-structures
